_comment: Output tokens/sec per model_id. Primary source: published benchmarks/blog posts mid-2025. Proxy for unknown models: K/sqrt(P_active_B) with K=600. as_of is the date of the primary source.

gpt-4o.source: OpenAI latency benchmarks blog 2025-Q1; community averaged ~60-65 tps

gpt-4o-mini.source: OpenAI documentation; community reports ~130-160 tps for mini variant

gpt-4-turbo.source: OpenAI latency benchmarks; larger model, slower throughput

claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022.source: Anthropic API speed tests; approx 70-85 tps for Sonnet class

claude-3-5-haiku-20241022.source: Anthropic documentation; Haiku is significantly faster than Sonnet

claude-3-opus-20240229.source: Anthropic benchmarks; Opus is slowest flagship model ~25-32 tps

claude-3-haiku-20240307.source: Anthropic documentation; Claude-3-Haiku fastest in family

gemini-1.5-pro.source: Google AI Studio latency reports mid-2025; ~50-60 tps

gemini-1.5-flash.source: Google AI Studio; Flash variant optimized for speed, ~200-240 tps

gemini-2.0-flash.source: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash official benchmarks early 2025

llama-3.1-8b-instruct.source: Open model; proxy K/sqrt(P)=600/sqrt(8)=212, rounded to community reported ~180-190

llama-3.1-70b-instruct.source: Open model; proxy K/sqrt(P)=600/sqrt(70)=71.7; community reports ~55-60 tps on A100

llama-3.1-405b-instruct.source: Open model; proxy K/sqrt(P)=600/sqrt(405)=29.8; large model slower

llama-3.2-3b-instruct.source: Proxy K/sqrt(P)=600/sqrt(3)=346; very small model, community reports ~250-300 tps

llama-3.2-1b-instruct.source: Proxy K/sqrt(P)=600/sqrt(1)=600; very small model significantly faster

mixtral-8x7b-instruct.source: MoE model, active params ~12B; proxy K/sqrt(12)=173; community ~100-120 tps

mixtral-8x22b-instruct.source: MoE model, active params ~39B; proxy K/sqrt(39)=96; community ~55-65 tps

mistral-large.source: Proprietary Mistral Large; ~123B estimated active params; proxy K/sqrt(123)=54

qwen2.5-72b-instruct.source: Proxy K/sqrt(72)=70.7; community reports ~50-55 tps on A100

deepseek-v2.source: DeepSeek V2 MoE, active params ~21B; proxy K/sqrt(21)=130; API reports ~70 tps

deepseek-v3.source: DeepSeek V3 MoE, active params ~37B; proxy K/sqrt(37)=98; API reports ~55 tps

__proxy_formula: K / sqrt(P_active_B) where P_active_B is active parameter count in billions
